# Email Sandbox

> Email Sandbox is an SMTP email testing platform for developers. It captures development and staging messages for inspection instead of relaying them to real recipients.

Free is the only plan available for self-service signup. Other plans are coming soon. This is an email testing sandbox, not a production email delivery service. Only public product information is included; no account data, captured emails, or credentials are published.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://email.dsourav.com/): Features, interactive demo, plan allowances, and frequently asked questions.
- [SMTP email testing guide](https://email.dsourav.com/docs): Account activation, SMTP configuration, message inspection, organization roles, and troubleshooting.

## Text resources

- [SMTP guide in Markdown](https://email.dsourav.com/docs/email-testing.md): The public guide in plain Markdown.
- [Full product context](https://email.dsourav.com/llms-full.txt): Product facts, plan limits, guide, and FAQ in one text file.
